runtimeEncoding: the lossy 1024x1024 q86/m6/sharp-YUV stage is decoded, opposite 1px borders are averaged onto both sides, and the exact-periodic pixels are stored as lossless WebP with metadata stripped — the decoded runtime artifact, not the pre-encode source, is what passed

runtimeWiring.colourSpace: WebP bytes are sRGB and are uploaded as WebGL2 SRGB8_ALPHA8, so sampling decodes once to linear before room lighting and the shader's final display encoding.
runtimeWiring.note: Wiring mirrors the guardroom's division of labour: the generated wall map supplies courses and chips while the room palette owns value and hue. The approved object callout sheet is dressing-eligible later; nothing from it was baked into these albedos.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source albedo texture for The Dog-leg Passage wall masonry in Crown Lab
Primary request: create a square edge-to-edge field of near-black navy dressed-stone wall blocks in compact staggered horizontal ashlar courses, matching the approved Dog-leg Passage material board's dark masonry language. Restrained hand-painted mineral variation, sparse tiny chips, very few cracks, calm low contrast.
Style/medium: stylized graphic game albedo, non-photographic
Composition/framing: orthographic straight-on surface filling the entire square canvas, uniform texel density, no isolated sample tile, no border. Keep the pattern rhythm regular enough to survive mirrored periodic finishing without an obvious central motif.
Lighting/mood: flat intrinsic color only; no directional light, bevel lighting, ambient occlusion, cast shadow, highlight, glow, or vignette
Color palette: blue-black and charcoal navy with only very subtle cool-grey mineral variation
Constraints: architecture material only; no floor pattern, gold, window, glass, fabric, wood, soot streaks, rubble, dirt piles, symbols, frame, objects, text, or watermark
Avoid: photorealism, perspective, depth-of-field, presentation board, swatch card, edge darkening, large unique cracks
